metadata.title: {nome} — Restaurant in Angeiras, Matosinhos
metadata.description: Neighbourhood restaurant inside the Angeiras campsite. Daily specials, fresh fish and home cooking, at everyday prices.

hero.descricao: Neighbourhood restaurant inside the Angeiras campsite. Daily specials, fresh fish and home cooking, at everyday prices.

sobre.paragrafo1: At Mira Mar we cook every day like at home: plenty of daily specials, fresh fish and good quality meat, at everyday prices. We're inside the Angeiras campsite, in a simple and welcoming setting where regulars feel at home from day one.
sobre.paragrafo2: No fuss, no rush — just good food, served with care, every day of the week.

ementaDestaque.descricao: Fresh fish, good quality meat and the daily special — home cooking at everyday prices.
